title: EDC 2000 quick
description:
I'm legitimately surprised I never uploaded this before. Found this short video for the year 2000 Electric Daisy Carnival on the November 2000 URB magazine sampler cd back in 2010. I never knew it was there. And for anyone who cares about such things, the file is dated Thursday, September 14th, 2000. Anyways, this is but a quick clip, and the full video can be found here: https://youtu.be/D4I0_wt9XAQ

Those were the days...
